name: After § 30
title: REPORT on the control of the financial activities of the European Investment Bank Group – annual report 2024
part_text: 30a. Insists that the EIB Group systematically conduct independent ex ante human rights impact assessments for all projects outside the EU, with meaningful consultation of local communities, civil society actors and human rights defenders; calls for these assessments to be made publicly available prior to project approval, and for projects outside the EU to be subject to transparency, environmental, social and human rights standards equivalent to those applied within the EU, without any double standards in environmental, social and governance and human rights safeguards;
